bio.text: Yudelka Tapia represents the 86th Assembly District in the Bronx in the New York State Assembly, which covers University Heights, Morris Heights, Mount Eden, Kingsbridge, Tremont and Fordham.

According to her Assembly biography, she was born in the Dominican Republic, attended O&M University in Santo Domingo, and earned a Master of Science in Urban Policy and Leadership from Hunter College.
The biography says she has lived in the West Bronx for over 30 years and has worked for 23 years as a Senior Auditor in the New York City Comptroller's Office.
